text:
Ivy (PM): Hey team — Acme pilot asked for model-level caching + HSM compatibility. We need a clear deploy choreography and minimal scope to hit pilot by month-end. Who owns sequencing and what can we push to later?

Samir (Eng): Runtime needs: KV cache eviction policy, simple variant routing to a quantized model, and a 10% canary switch. Dev estimate: ~3w + 1w validation. Blocking: KMS/HSM choice and infra flags.

Jonah (Runtime): Addendum: runtime will also need pinned model manifests and a safe fallback path. No prefetch/batching changes for pilot — too risky. Plan to gate with a feature flag.

Priya (Infra): Quick infra note: hosted KMS + customer CMK is fastest (days). Customer-managed HSM onboarding is ~4w (contracts, provisioning, ops runbook). VPC/network review for on-prem adds 2-5 business days. Need explicit confirmation from Acme.

Eli (Security): I'll start threat model and checklist. If keys must stay on a customer HSM we need full dataflow and audit paths. Hosted KMS requires documenting key access controls and rotation. Share design doc and a small anonymized sample dataset for regression.

Ivy (PM): Proposed sequencing: 1) runtime implementation (Samir/Jonah), 2) infra KMS decision + provisioning (Priya/Hans), 3) security review (Eli), 4) SRE canary orchestration (Nina). Soft launch estimate w/ hosted KMS: ~5w. With HSM: ~9w.

Samir (Eng): 5w workable if scope is frozen: routing + eviction only. No batching or scheduler changes. Need two dev sprints and a regression harness. I'll reserve cycles.

Jonah (Runtime): I'll create the canary prototype and model manifest gating. Canary rules: 10% traffic, auto-fallback on error or latency regression. Will emit KV metrics (hit rate, evictions).

Nina (SRE): We can operate the canary. Need runbook with thresholds: P95 latency > 200ms or error rate >1% sustained for 5m triggers rollback. We'll staff oncall for first 48h. Also need automation to shift traffic weights.

Hans (Procurement): If Acme insists on HSM, procurement needs PO + contract; provisioning timeline ~3w after PO. Hans available to coordinate, but we need signed intent.

Priya (Infra): If Acme accepts hosted KMS (customer CMK), infra work is small: provision key, configure IAM bindings, expose flag to runtime. If HSM chosen, we need dedicated ops runway and physical provisioning.

Ivy (PM): I'm asking Acme to accept hosted KMS for pilot (they said HSM is "preferred" but not mandatory). I'll push for hosted KMS to meet pilot date and report back in 24h.

Eli (Security): Meanwhile I'll draft checklist items: dataflow diagram, key lifecycle, audit log destination, required headers, and expected crypto ops (sign/encrypt). Please attach the design doc to this thread.

Samir (Eng): CI/rollout idea: `/deploy canary --percent 10 --model model-v2` plus smoke tests hitting both routes and asserting fallback. Need infra flag and a test harness that simulates KV warmup.

Jonah (Runtime): Ticket ROUTE-781 created: "variant routing + canary support + KV metrics". Target PR by Thu.

Ivy (PM): Action items recap: Ivy confirm KMS/HSM preference (24h); Samir/Jonah deliver dev plan and PR timeline; Priya/Hans confirm procurement lead times if HSM; Eli produce security checklist; Nina draft runbook and automation playbook. Sync Friday 10:00am. :thumbsup:
